claims.claim_text_en: A national drought management plan was adopted in 2023 and requires herder communities to keep emergency fodder reserves.

brief.core_idea_en: For livestock and rangelands, the pages read contain one measure: the 2023 National Drought Management Plan requires herder communities to keep emergency fodder reserves. Pasture management, livestock health and enteric emissions are not covered in the pages read.

responses.text_en: Herder communities must maintain emergency fodder reserves under the 2023 National Drought Management Plan (NDC 3.0, p. 30).

gaps.text_en: 'Emergency fodder reserves' has no topic of its own; it is logged as an unmapped concept for taxonomy review.
